items.source: Provider for asynchronous MCP resource methods. This provider creates resource specifications for methods annotated with McpResource that are designed to work with McpAsyncServerExchange and return reactive types.
items.translation: 异步 MCP 资源方法的提供者。 此提供者为使用McpResource注解且专为与McpAsyncServerExchange协作并返回反应式类型而设计的方法创建资源规范。

items.source: resourceObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpResource
items.translation: resourceObjects - 包含用 McpResource 注解的方法的对象。
